Geef je de nodige gegevens in het datacaptatiesysteem in. Geef je de goedgekeurde producten vrij en stapel je ze in baskets. Zorg je voor een propere en veilige werkpost. Profiel Je kan zelfstandig opdrachten uitvoeren Je bent nauwkeurig en flexibel ingesteld Je bent bereid om in een nachtploeg na een inwerkperiode van enkele maanden in tweeploegen Ons aanbod Wie bij Samsonite aan de slag gaat, kan rekenen op een boeiende en veelzijdige werkomgeving binnen een internationale context. Je komt terecht in een moderne en goed uitgeruste werkplaats. Je inzet en deskundigheid belonen wij met een concurrentieel salaris. ACERCA DEL EQUIPO Why You'll Love Working Here Our employees matter. As a people-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based. Vibrant culture. We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day. Socially responsible. We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models. What We Value At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily. Samsonite is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

review_candidates.title: Packaging Operator
review_candidates.description: Na Medinfar, o teu trabalho tem impacto real: ajudar a levar cuidados de saúde a todos. Junta-te a uma equipa movida por propósito, inovação, ética e sustentabilidade. 👉 Juntos cuidamos melhor. O teu papel na Medinfar Como Packaging Operator , vais ter um papel essencial no processo de acondicionamento dos produtos, assegurando que as operações de embalagem e rotulagem são realizadas de forma rigorosa, eficiente e de acordo com os procedimentos internos, as Boas Práticas de Fabrico e os requisitos de qualidade aplicáveis. Como vais fazer a diferença? Qualidade e rigor: Realizar as atividades de acondicionamento e embalagem de produtos farmacêuticos, garantindo o correto cumprimento dos procedimentos e das Boas Práticas de Fabrico. Atenção ao detalhe: Identificar corretamente produtos, materiais, equipamentos e instalações, efetuar os registos associados às operações e reportar eventuais desvios aos standards definidos. Operação de equipamentos: Participar na higienização, mudança de formato, montagem, desmontagem, afinação e operação das máquinas de acondicionamento, cumprindo as regras de higiene e segurança. Organização e eficiência: Executar as operações com prontidão, diligência e eficácia, contribuindo para o cumprimento dos objetivos de produtividade da área. Gestão de materiais: Acompanhar as necessidades das linhas de embalagem, assegurando a reposição, retirada, transporte e verificação dos materiais necessários ao processo. Fiabilidade da informação: Garantir o correto preenchimento da documentação e dos registos das operações, incluindo consumos e devoluções associados às Ordens de Produção. Segurança e boas práticas: Cumprir as normas de fardamento, circulação, higiene e segurança, contribuindo para minimizar riscos de contaminação e assegurar a qualidade do produto. O que procuramos: Escolaridade mínima obrigatória, preferencialmente 12.º ano ou equivalente. Sentido de responsabilidade, rigor e atenção ao detalhe. Capacidade de organização e cumprimento de procedimentos. Facilidade de trabalho em equipa e espírito de colaboração. Conhecimentos básicos de informática na ótica do utilizador. Valorizamos conhecimentos de Boas Práticas de Fabrico e de funcionamento/setup de máquinas de acondicionamento. Disponibilidade para turnos Porquê a Medinfar? Porque aqui vais encontrar mais do que um desafio profissional. Vais encontrar propósito, impacto, crescimento e uma equipa que acredita que, quando cuidamos uns dos outros, cuidamos melhor de todos. Ajuda-nos a construir um futuro melhor para todos. 👉 Juntos cuidamos melhor.

review_candidates.title: Operator - Matrijswisselaar
review_candidates.description: QUIÉNES SOMOS Who We Are Samsonite is the worldwide leader in superior travel bags, luggage, and accessories combining notable style with the latest design technology and the utmost attention to quality and durability. For more than 100 years, Samsonite has leveraged its rich heritage to create unparalleled products that fulfill the travel lifestyle needs of conscious movers everywhere. With a portfolio of brands including Samsonite, Tumi, American Tourister, High Sierra, Gregory, Hartmann, and Lipault Paris, our products are sold in over 100 countries in North America, Asia, Europe and Latin America through our company-operated retail store, websites and a variety of retail partners. DESCRIPCIÓN DE PUESTO Functie Je bemant 2 grote injectie- of pressformingsmachines. Je voert matrijswissels uit volgens planning en start de machine op na een set-up of defect. Je voert controles uit en geeft volgens de instructies productie vrij. Je vangt de eerste productie- en procesproblemen op. Op aanvraag voer je proefspuitingen uit op productiematrijzen. Je zal de operators begeleiden bij het uitvoeren van hun taak. Je voert indien nodig baskets weg mbv een stapelaar. Je staat in voor het uitvoeren van kleurwissels en het aanleggen van kleur- en werkstandaards. Aanbod Wie bij Samsonite aan de slag gaat kan rekenen op een boeiende en veelzijdige werkomgeving binnen een internationale context. Je komt terecht in een moderne en goed uitgeruste werkplaats. Je inzet en deskundigheid belonen wij met een concurrentieel salaris. Profiel Je bent in het bezit van een diploma A2 of A3 Mechanica of je hebt reeds enkele jaren ervaring in een gelijkaardig functie. Je hebt technisch inzicht en een passie voor mechanica. Je bent in het bezit van een brevet voor het besturen van een heftruck, hoogwerker en rolbrug of je bent bereid dit te behalen. Je kan zelfstandig opdrachten uitvoeren. Je bent nauwkeurig, probleemoplossend en flexibel ingesteld. Je bent bereid om in een 2-ploegenstelsel te werken na de inwerkperiode. ACERCA DEL EQUIPO Why You'll Love Working Here Our employees matter. As a people-focused business, we work hard to provide meaningful rewards and development opportunities for our employees, recognizing performance, and creating a supportive working environment for them, wherever they are based. Vibrant culture. We are committed to a diverse and rich culture, welcoming people from all walks of life. Our long-standing commitment to culture and inclusion empowers us to bring our authentic selves and unique differences to work every day. Socially responsible. We want to minimize our products' impact on the environment and help create positive journeys worldwide. We do this by creating the best products using the most sustainable and innovative materials, methods, and models. What We Value At Samsonite, we do more than create the bags that move with our consumer, we inspire and celebrate the moments that move them. We believe we have a responsibility to the world in how we operate, the products we sell, the communities where we live and work, and how we treat the people we employ. We're as diverse as travel itself, and like travel, your journey with Samsonite presents the opportunity to be a part of something bigger and explore your passions. This is why we offer various paths for professionals and celebrate the knowledge and skills they bring to our team. We are committed to a respectful workplace that allows our team members to bring their best selves to the workplace daily. Samsonite is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to promoting and maintaining a work environment in which all applicants, associates, customers, and other individuals are treated with dignity and respect free from unlawful harassment, discrimination, or retaliation.

review_candidates.title: Maintenance Supervisor
review_candidates.description: Job Description The Maintenance Supervisor oversees all maintenance activities within the joinery workshop and metal fabrication facility. This role ensures maximum uptime, safety, and efficiency of specialized machinery by leading a team of technicians, executing preventative maintenance schedules, and troubleshooting mechanical, electrical, and pneumatic systems. Key Responsibilities Supervise, train, and schedule daily tasks for maintenance technicians and assistants. Develop and execute PM schedules for all joinery and metalworking machinery. Diagnose and repair mechanical, electrical, hydraulic, and pneumatic equipment failure rapidly. Coordinate with external contractors and OEM technicians for specialized machinery servicing. Manage spare parts inventory, ordering critical components to minimize production downtime. Enforce strict health and safety protocols, ensuring all machinery guards and extraction systems function correctly. Oversee general factory infrastructure, including compressed air systems, power distribution, and dust extraction. Required Skills & Qualifications Experience: Minimum 5 years in industrial maintenance, with at least 2 years in a supervisory role within joinery, furniture manufacturing and metal fabrication environments. Technical Knowledge: Deep understanding of specialized machinery, including: Joinery: CNC Beam Saw s, CNC routers, edge banders, panel saws, spindle molders, Hot press, Cefla finishing line and central dust extraction systems. Metal Fabrication: CNC laser, press brakes, MIG/TIG welding machines, Sand blasting, Powder coating and compressors. Core Skills: Strong ability to read electrical schematics, hydraulic diagrams, and mechanical blueprints. Education: Diploma or Degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Mechatronics Engineering, or equivalent technical trade certification. Soft Skills: Excellent problem-solving abilities, strong communication, and the capacity to work under pressure to meet production deadlines. Familiar with ERP system.

review_candidates.title: Key Account Manager (DACH, Benelux & France)
review_candidates.description: MTS Globe Spain Who are we? MTS Globe is one of Europe’s leading destination management companies, operating in 66 destinations across 23 countries and serving over 11.5 million travellers each year. What do we do? We connect travel brands, tour operators, and hotels, delivering high-quality destination services through local expertise, strong partnerships, and advanced technology. We provide a full range of destination services - from hotel accommodation and transfers to excursions, guided tours and cruise handling. What do we offer? At MTS Globe, you’ll be part of an international environment where people collaborate across cultures and borders. We offer a dynamic workplace where talent can grow, learn, and build a global career. Why join us? Join an international and multicultural team where you can grow your career, develop globally, and be part of a company that is constantly evolving in a dynamic industry. JOIN US AND DISCOVER YOUR FUTURE WITH MTS GLOBE GROUP! MTS Globe is an equal opportunities employer. Job Description We are looking for an experienced Key Account Manager to join our Commercial team in Palma de Mallorca. This is a key position responsible for managing and developing our strategic partnerships across the DACH, Benelux and French source markets, with a particular focus on Germany and the Benelux region. The successful candidate will bring extensive experience in key account management within the tourism industry, a strong understanding of the main market players and business models in these regions, and solid knowledge of Spanish tourism products and destinations. The role requires close daily collaboration with our teams in Spain, as well as regular contact with tour operators, clients and commercial partners across the assigned source markets. Main responsibilities: Manage and further develop relationships with strategic key accounts across the DACH, Benelux and French markets. Managing existing clients, understanding their requirements and business models to ensure their needs are met. Build and maintain profitable partnerships with clients leading them to further growth. Acquisition of new clients, making their business model transparent and carrying out risk assessment. Developing and implementation of commercial strategies according to company goals and directions. Conducting market research and analysis to create detailed business plans for commercial opportunities (expansion, new business ideas etc.) Collaborate regularly with destination teams in the Balearic Islands, Canary Islands and the main coastal areas of mainland Spain. Monitor performance of commercial activities using exiting BI system and prepare reports for senior management and clients. Central point of contact for the clients and organization. Elaboration of commercial budget and forecast reports on a yearly/ quarterly basis for the assigned markets. Weekly monitoring of sales reports and analysis. Interpretation and execution of required action towards clients and the organization. Elaboration of key portfolios and joint opportunities together with clients & destinations. Elaboration, analysis and interpretation of competitive reports. Requirements Minimum 5 years working in a commercial, contracting or product management position. Degree in Tourism or Business Administration. Experience in contracting and product management and its commercialization. Experience in dynamic packaging Solid understanding of Spanish tourism destinations and products, particularly sun and beach destinations, including the Balearic Islands, Canary Islands and the main coastal areas of mainland Spain. Disposition to travel. Fluent English, German and Spanish, French will be a plus. Analytical skills, accustomed to working with a data warehouse. Understanding of the different source markets and Key market players of these areas.

review_candidates.title: KYC / Compliance Specialist
review_candidates.description: About Flow Corporation Flow Corporation owns a digital asset management platform, Team-Crypto, which allows clients to invest capital in the largest capitalisations on the crypto-asset market in a 100% automated way. As we expand into the European market, we have established F-Corp EU OÜ, our European entity in Tallinn, Estonia, which is preparing its regulatory authorisation in the EU. We are looking for a KYC / Compliance Specialist to join our European compliance team in Tallinn. This role is central to our client onboarding operations, ensuring that all customers are verified to the highest regulatory standards before accessing the Team-Crypto platform. The KYC / Compliance Specialist reports to the MLRO (Money Laundering Reporting Officer) and works closely with the operations and product teams to deliver a seamless yet compliant client experience. Key Responsibilities • Conduct thorough Know Your Customer (KYC) and Know Your Business (KYB) checks on all new clients, including identity verification, proof of address, and source of funds/wealth analysis. • Perform enhanced due diligence (EDD) on higher-risk clients, politically exposed persons (PEPs), and complex corporate structures. • Screen clients and transactions against international sanctions lists (EU, UN, OFAC) and adverse media databases. • Monitor ongoing client activity for suspicious patterns and escalate potential cases to the MLRO for further investigation. • Maintain accurate and up-to-date client records in compliance with Estonian and EU AML/CFT rules. • Contribute to the development and continuous improvement of internal KYC/AML policies and procedures. • Assist the MLRO in preparing suspicious transaction reports (STRs) and regulatory filings. • Support periodic client reviews and re-verification processes in line with the firm's risk-based approach. • Liaise with third-party KYC/AML service providers (e.g., ComplyAdvantage, Veriff, or similar) to ensure tool effectiveness and data accuracy. • Stay current with evolving AML/CFT and crypto-asset regulation and industry best practices. • Participate in internal training sessions and contribute to the compliance awareness culture within the organisation. Profile & Requirements • 1–3 years of experience in a KYC, AML, or compliance role within a fintech, crypto, or regulated financial institution. • Solid understanding of EU and Estonian AML/CFT rules and of EU regulation for crypto-assets. • Experience with KYC/AML tools and platforms (e.g., ComplyAdvantage, Chainalysis, Veriff, Sumsub, or equivalent). • Good understanding of blockchain and crypto-asset business models. • Fluent in English; proficiency in Estonian is a strong advantage. • Detail-oriented, rigorous, and able to manage multiple client files simultaneously. • Strong communication skills and ability to work in a fast-paced, international environment. • Based in or willing to relocate to Tallinn. • Relevant certification (e.g., ICA Certificate in KYC/CDD, ACAMS, or equivalent) is a plus. What We Offer • A hands-on compliance role in a fast-growing European fintech. • Competitive salary commensurate with experience. • Flexible working arrangements (hybrid, based in Tallinn). • Career growth opportunities as the European entity scales. • A collaborative, international team with offices in Mauritius and Estonia. • The chance to join an entity preparing its EU authorisation, from the ground up. How to Apply Please send your CV and a brief cover letter to talents@team-flow-corporation.com with the reference FC-EE02-KYC in the subject line. An AI tool helps us check the factual requirements of the role (location, experience, languages, certifications); a person reviews every application and takes every decision. Shortlisted applications may be shared with our regulatory adviser. More on how we handle your data in our acknowledgement of receipt.
